messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clarify.ai>, Priya Singh <priya@clarify.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Draft MAP blueprint + week0 ops checklist — ClarifyAI pilot

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Great to meet virtually last week. As promised, I’m sharing a first-pass MAP (mutual action plan) we can co-edit for the pilot. The doc is focused on a tightly scoped 30-day evaluation with clear week0 readiness gates so your engineers can validate integration quickly.

What’s included in the draft:
- Shared success criteria (latency targets, sample throughput, quality pass/fail)
- Week0 ops checklist (credentials, VPC peering, test dataset handoff, logging hooks)
- Milestones & acceptance gates for Day 7 / Day 21 / Day 30
- Owner lanes (Redwood: onboarding + infra; ClarifyAI: data handoff + test plan)

Ask: please co-edit the MAP doc below with any changes to owners or timelines by end of week so we can lock the pilot kickoff. If OK, we’ll prep slides for the kickoff and book a 30–45 minute workshop to run through week0 steps.

Google Doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbcMAPBlueprint/edit
Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/clarifyai-pilot-assets

Attachments (stubs):
- MAP-Blueprint-v1.gdoc (editable)
- slide-deck-seed.gslides (kickoff slides)
- week0-ops-checklist.xlsx (detailed ops tasks)

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0: ops readiness + test dataset handoff
- Week 1–3: integration + validation (daily standups optional)
- Day 30: acceptance review and decision to convert to Dedicated/Hosted as discussed

If you’d like a longer runway (45 days) we can accommodate — calling that out explicitly to align expectations.

Thanks — looking forward to your notes.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0123

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear draft and the assets. Priya and I skimmed the MAP and we like the structure. A couple of quick asks:

1) Security evidence: before we start week0 we need a SOC2 summary and a short architecture diagram that confirms data-in-rest controls for dedicated instances. Can you point us to the report or drop a one-page?
2) Timeline: our legal + procurement would prefer a 45-day pilot window to give stakeholders time for the acceptance review. Is that something Redwood can support?
3) Pricing: can you include a rough price band for the 30-day vs 45-day pilot so we can budget ahead of procurement outreach?

We scheduled time for a technical call next Wed 9/15 at 10am PT to cover the integration checklist — would you and a solutions engineer be available?

Appreciate it — we’ll add inline comments to the doc this afternoon.

— Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, Clarify AI
sanjay@clarify.ai

Sanjay / Priya —

Quick answers inline:

1) SOC2: we can share the SOC2 Type II summary and the one-page controls diagram. Here’s a short link to the security packet (read-only): https://redwood.example.com/soc2/summary-2026. I’ll also paste the architecture diagram into the MAP doc later today.

2) Timeline: we can run either a 30-day or 45-day pilot. Our recommendation is 30 days if the goal is a quick validation to unblock procurement; if you expect more stakeholder review cycles, 45 days is reasonable. We’ll add both cadence options in the MAP with acceptance criteria adjusted for each.

3) Pricing: ballpark (pilot-only, non-production):
- 30-day: $6k–$9k (depends on token volume and KV cache needs)
- 45-day: $8k–$12k (includes modest buffer for extended validation)
Final pricing depends on traffic profile; we’ll include a worked example once we have sample token/hour.

We’ll join the tech call on 9/15 at 10am PT — I’ll bring our lead solutions engineer (Jonas will join as well).
